name: io.github.allooloo/cm-kg
title: Capital Markets Agents: MCP+A2A Canada
description: Know every Canadian and UK issuer, agent-ready. Instantly. Provably. Eleven markets, in-country.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.access: read-only, public-record only; no prices, quotes or licensed market data

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI and return its record summary, node and current version.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full Capital Markets Record for an issuer, with per-field source, reader and state; optionally a prior version.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Return dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer (releases, bulletins, halts, corporate actions, statement and record dates) since a date.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: Return the sourced trade and former names an issuer releases under.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Return the twelve market nodes and which are live.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description_of_record: Know every Canadian and United Kingdom issuer, agent-ready. Instantly. Provably. Ten markets on the same record — Toronto to Tokyo — served in-country.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description_note: The registry caps description at 100 characters; the description of record (CEO, Sept 12 2026) is carried here in full.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.estate: ORDER-018 sovereign estate: eleven regional doors on Azure Container Apps (records and events served in their own jurisdiction), apex router index-only on Cloudflare, an A2A Agent Card per node at agent.<node>-cm-kg.ai and at agent.capitalmarketsknowledgegraph.ai
